name: image-gallery
description: Improve image browsing experience, especially for remote development.

sorting.byPathOptions.localeMatcher.markdownDescription: The locale matching algorithm to use. Possible values are "`lookup`" and "`best fit`".

sorting.byPathOptions.sensitivity.markdownDescription:
Which differences in the strings should be taken into account. Possible values are:
- "`base`": Only strings that differ in base letters compare as unequal. Examples: a ≠ b, a = á, a = A.
- "`accent`": Only strings that differ in base letters or accents compare as unequal. Examples: a ≠ b, a ≠ á, a = A.
- "`case`": Only strings that differ in base letters or case compare as unequal. Examples: a ≠ b, a = á, a ≠ A.
- "`variant`": All strings compare as unequal.

sorting.byPathOptions.numeric.markdownDescription: Whether numeric collation should be used, such that "`img1.jpg`" > "`img2.jpg`" > "`img10.jpg`", instead of "`img1.jpg`" > "`img10.jpg`" > "`img2.jpg`".

sorting.byPathOptions.caseFirst.markdownDescription: Whether upper case or lower case should sort first. Possible values are "`upper`", "`lower`" or "`false`" (use the locale's default).

sorting.byPathOptions.collation.markdownDescription:
Variant collations for certain locales. Possible values include:
- "`compat`" - Arabic
- "`dict`" - Sinhala
- "`emoji`" - root
- "`eor`" - root
- "`phonebk`" - German
- "`phonetic`" - Lingala
- "`pinyin`" - Chinese
- "`reformed`" - Swedish
- "`stroke`" - Chinese
- "`trad`"
- "`zhuyin`" - Chinese

enumDescriptions: Only generate thumbnails in remote sessions (SSH, WSL, Containers, etc.)
Never generate thumbnails, always load original images
imageGallery.thumbnail.enabled.markdownDescription: When to enable backend thumbnail compression.

imageGallery.thumbnail.maxSize.markdownDescription: Maximum width/height of generated thumbnails in pixels.

imageGallery.thumbnail.format.markdownDescription: Output format for thumbnails. WebP offers better compression.

imageGallery.thumbnail.diskCacheSizeMB.markdownDescription: Maximum disk cache size for thumbnails in MB.

imageGallery.thumbnail.skipFormats.markdownDescription: File formats to skip thumbnail generation for (served as-is). Add `gif` to preserve animations.

imageGallery.thumbnail.waitForThumbnail.markdownDescription: When `true`, show placeholder until thumbnail is ready (saves bandwidth). When `false`, load original image immediately for faster visual feedback.
